profile_text.body:
The material provided is inconsistent: the website text describes Dexus, an Australasian real estate and infrastructure fund manager, while the company record is for DXC Technology Co, an SEC registrant headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, trading under the ticker DXC. The site text says Dexus has four decades of experience in real asset investment, funds management, asset management and development, and describes a multi-billion dollar portfolio. It also states that Dexus Funds Management Limited is the responsible entity of the fund, which comprises Dexus Property Trust and Dexus Operations Trust.

The held facts contain no products, no lawsuits, and no MCP servers for DXC Technology Co. The only additional facts are that it is a for-profit public company registered with the SEC under CIK 0001688568, headquartered in Ashburn, Virginia, and that Virginia is listed as a jurisdiction with a count of 152.

Because the website text and the company record appear to describe different entities, no reliable profile of DXC Technology Co's business or AI position can be written from this data.
